verdict.rationale: Docs detail multiple fast-pairing paths (registration code, serial number, order number, or pairing code entered in Dashboard/API) that let a merchant register a reader immediately after unboxing without physical possession, and readers must simply be assigned to a location to start taking payments. Community evidence corroborates that Terminal's hardware/API integration works well in practice, though it also notes hardware integration complexity for custom builds. Missing for 10: independent hands-on timing data confirming the 'within minutes' claim and broader third-party validation beyond a single HN anecdote.
